test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

You have hurt so many people. Now, it is time __to get a taste of your own medicine__.

options.text: to be treated the way you have treated others
to be in a risky situation
to lose control in a situation
to benefit from two different opportunities

solution: The correct answer is **to be treated the way you have treated others.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"get a taste of your own medicine"** means to experience the same unpleasant treatment that one has given to others. (जैसे को तैसा सहना) • **Example:** After years of rude behaviour towards his colleagues, he finally got a taste of his own medicine when his new manager treated him the same way. • **"To be treated the way you have treated others"** conveys the same meaning as "get a taste of your own medicine". (आपने दूसरों के साथ जैसा व्यवहार किया है, वैसा ही आपके साथ किया जाएगा) • **Example:** If you bully others, don’t be surprised when you are bullied back. It's just getting treated the way you have treated others. • Hence, we can say that "**to be treated the way you have treated others**" is the correct substitution for "**get a taste of your own medicine**". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To be in a risky situation** (एक जोखिम भरी स्थिति में होना): Facing circumstances that involve potential danger or loss. • **Example:** He knew he was in a risky situation when he decided to climb the mountain without proper gear. • **To lose control in a situation** (एक स्थिति में नियंत्रण खोना): To be unable to manage or deal with conditions effectively. • **Example:** She started to lose control of the meeting when everyone began talking at once. • **To benefit from two different opportunities** (दो अलग-अलग अवसरों से लाभ उठाना): To take advantage of two distinct chances or favorable conditions. • **Example:** By working remotely, he got to travel the world and still keep his job, thus benefiting from two different opportunities. 3b:Tb0a, The correct answer is: Betrothed.
